mapper.select: SELECT ts.id, ts.trip_id, ts.trip_country_id, c.country_name, c.time_zone, ts.schedule_name, ts.start_at, ts.end_at, ts.amount, cur.currency_code, cur.symbol AS currency_symbol, ts.payment_status, ts.schedule_status, ts.place_name, ts.place_address FROM trip_schedules ts INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = ts.trip_id LEFT JOIN trip_countries tc ON tc.id = ts.trip_country_id AND tc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id LEFT JOIN currencies cur ON cur.id = COALESCE(ts.currency_id, c.currency_id) WHERE ts.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ts.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ts.start_at ASC, ts.id ASC
